spanish: y fuere conocido el pecado que pecaron sobre ella, y acercarán la asamblea toro hijo de ganado a pecado, y lo traerán delante de tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: Hiphil 3cp וְהִקְרִיבוּ takes הַקָּהָל as subject and פַּר as what is brought near; «acercarán la asamblea toro» makes the assembly the object and leaves the bull as a second object.
The 3fs suffix on עָלֶיהָ resumes feminine הַחַטָּאת; «ella» cannot resume masculine «el pecado», so the pronoun no longer points to the sin.

notes: Remaining tokens match: niphal be-known, the sin they sinned, bull son of cattle for a sin, and bringing it before the tent of meeting.
